title: IPC admin.endpoints.set_advertise params
description: Set whether an endpoint may appear in the directory (IPC 3.0; ADR-0061 decision 5). For an authored endpoint the endpoint overlay's `advertise` delta is written, a delta equal to the authored value not kept; for an added one its entry's member. A value already in effect is answered with nothing written; a value the composed profile would refuse (`directory.max_advertised`) is `InvalidArgument`, nothing written. The overlay is synced and the directory's answer source updated before the answer, which is `empty-result`.
